history.period: late 19th century (exact church-building date not verifiable — flag)
history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — keep-or-drop decision needed. A CHRISTIAN CHURCH of the Presbyterian tradition. In the 1890s Mawphlang was the hub of the Presbyterian Church of Wales' missionary and medical activity in the Khasi Hills: Dr Griffith Griffiths of Brynmawr established a dispensary and then clinic here in 1878 (he died at Mawphlang on 22 April 1892); missionary William Williams also died at Mawphlang. The Mawphlang Presbyterian Church (Mission Compound) continues as an active congregation of the Presbyterian Church of India (Presbytery Mawphlang), and a community project (Ka Khrawsing Christian College) was raised as a Presbytery silver-jubilee memorial. The exact founding date of the present church building could not be verified from web sources — flag as uncertain. CSV 'state' column wrongly holds the town name; real state is MEGHALAYA.
